answer: Deposits are visible in marble, and trellis reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 88 aliases, and each one needs its own funded cedar account. A bond of 22% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That is 643 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
